title: How much rock salt a lakeshore city's roads division commits above its rolled-over supply contract for the first winter after a bus network redesign moved 424 lane-km of collectors to bare-pavement service, when the collectors it moved before were streets its hazard-spot salting already covered along much of their length
subdomain: municipal service demand and resource allocation (a city's winter road salt for a change of service level, forecast from the spreader records of the streets that went through the same change before, conditioned on how much of each street the old service already salted)
prompt_shape: a committed seasonal tonnage to the nearest 100 t, each works yard's dome stock and room on 1 November 2026, each yard's Priority 1 arterial rock salt in each of three winters, and a one-page report to council charting the arterial figures
